system_prompt_style.evidence_quote: Each Worker is instantiated as an independent agent with its own system prompt and isolated context window
system_prompt_style.note: Per-role system prompts; the construction mechanism is not described. Paper only.

env_context_strategy.note: Paper only; no repository or configuration was available. RAG is mentioned for knowledge retrieval mode, but the retrieval mechanism is unspecified.

context_compaction.evidence_quote: The Context State (ct) utilizes rolling summaries of tool outputs to keep the LLM context window manageable.

observation_format.note: Paper only; the observation format is not described.

tool_call_format.note: Paper only; tools are called via MCP, but the model-side call syntax is not stated.

tool_count.note: Paper only; no tool registry was available.

edit_primitive.note: Paper only; no code-editing tool is described, and the paper is not the place where one would be declared.

tool_schema_source.evidence_quote: To manage the heterogeneity of biomedical tools—ranging from local Python scripts and Docker containers to remote cloud APIs—we utilize MCP.

protocol_standardization.evidence_quote: These layers are interconnected via the Model Context Protocol (MCP), a standardized bus that abstracts heterogeneous biological tools

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: Our control plane operationalizes a bounded plan–execute–reflect loop with replanning, tailored for scientific tasks.
loop_primitives.note: Workers use a ReAct-like loop per Fig. 1. Layer B skill graphs are fixed LangGraph pipelines.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: Upon receiving a complex request, the Supervisor generates a high-level plan consisting of minimal necessary steps.
planning_granularity.note: A supervisor plan with steps delegated to workers (Algorithm 1).

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: Layer A implements a Supervisor-Worker Hierarchical Agent System.

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: Each Worker is instantiated as an independent agent with its own system prompt and isolated context window

human_in_loop.evidence_quote: The interface allows expert scientists not only to approve or reject results but also to perform parameter correction or trigger a rollback to a previous state.
human_in_loop.note: HITL gates are graph nodes that pause at decision boundaries.

short_term_state.evidence_quote: the Artifact State (Dt) tracks the actual files and data objects (SMILES lists, SDF files, docking grids) stored in the filesystem

long_term_memory.note: Paper only. Future work mentions long-term case-based retrieval, but there is no code to open.

state_persistence.evidence_quote: We implement Layer B using LangGraph, allowing us to encode long-horizon workflows as cyclic graphs with persistence and state management.

self_verification.evidence_quote: The loop integrates a reflection mechanism—implemented as a self-correction prompt rather than a separate critic agent—to evaluate the completion status after each step.

retry_policy.note: Paper only. Replanning is described, but whole-task retry is not.

rollback.evidence_quote: trigger a rollback to a previous state
rollback.note: The mechanism is unspecified; this is presumably the LangGraph state checkpoint.

termination_condition.note: Early stopping on SUFFICIENT_INFO is a reflect decision.

cost_controls.note: Paper only. It mentions a budget constraint but gives no mechanism.

execution_isolation.note: Paper only. Tools run via MCP servers, which may be Docker or remote; the agent execution boundary is unspecified.

network_policy.note: Paper only; no network configuration surface was available.

permission_model.evidence_quote: Strict Mode, used in production, which physically restricts the tool list available to a worker based on its role
permission_model.note: Role-based tool filtering. Permissive Mode exposes the full toolset.

tracing.evidence_quote: the system implements Provenance Tracking, recording the lineage of every artifact—capturing which agent, tool, and parameters generated it

replayability.note: Paper only. A replay aspiration is stated in Sec. 3.4, but no mechanism is described.

eval_hooks.note: The PharmaBench benchmark exists, but no repository was available to check for a runner.

guardrails.evidence_quote: We incorporate Format Adapters at the input and output of each node. These adapters programmatically validate and clean data
guardrails.note: Role-based tool filtering and data contracts.

target_domain.evidence_quote: Tool-augmented large language model (LLM) agents promise to unify scientific reasoning with computation

open_source.note: No repository or licence was in the evidence.

model_agnostic.note: Run with Qwen3 and DeepSeek backends.

primary_artifact.evidence_quote: Governed Autonomy for Drug Discovery LLM Agents

pinned_version.note: No repository; pinned to the paper version.
